items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: I've forgotten this fella's name. Some fella from downtown he used on piano. But ordinarily he has Sing Miller. Sometimes. Sometimes. He's playing with Kimble now.

ctx.x: Gerald Joseph. That's right. And he has Joe Harris on the alto. Alto. And he must be using piano now if he doesn't use it at all. Piano.

Yeah. Sing didn't go with us this year. I've forgotten this fella's name. Some fella from downtown he used on piano. But ordinarily he has Sing Miller. Sometimes. Sometimes. He's playing with Kimble now. Miller is. Oh really? He plays with Kimble. I didn't know that.

Yeah, I should ask Charlie Hamilton about that. I saw him the other day when they opened the bank in the National City Bank. Charlie Hamilton was there. Charlie Hamilton was there. Or you was there too? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
